messages:
Ana: Heads-up: review window closes in 5 days. Please remind ICs to submit self-assessments early — timezone quirks hit last cycle.

Leo: Can we change the soft deadline reminder to 72h instead of 48h? Some APAC folks missed the 48h ping.

Maya: We can shift the reminder for rolling timezones. Proposed: 72h for APAC teams, 48h for NA/EU. Ops-bot can send per-team schedule if teams are tagged correctly.

ops-bot: Reminder policy: sending schedule can be configured per-team via the console. Endpoint: /api/v1/notifications/config. Default: 48h global.

Leo: Also need clarity on late self-assessments: if an IC submits after 24h post-close, do managers still have to score on-time? We had inconsistent handling.

Maya: Policy: final close is hard for peer-feedback. Self-assessments accepted up to 72h after close but marked as "late" in the audit. Managers should include late flags in calibration notes; late self-assessments do not change calibration buckets unless exception approved.

Ana: Good. Can we get an export column for "self_assessment_submitted_at" to help track?

ops-bot: New export column added: self_assessment_submitted_at. Available in tonight's roster CSV.

Maya: Small ops note: if a reviewer is assigned >30 handbacks overnight, system will auto-throttle new assignments and notify team leads. We added that after last cycle.

Ana: Perfect. One quick ask: can the manager-facing email include a link to the exact feedback items that are late so they don't have to search?

Maya: Adding deep links. Will include up to 10 late items in the email with anchor links to the console.

ops-bot: Ticket created: PR-4723 for reminder schedule changes and email deep-linking. Assigned to Maya.
